subject.title: fix(browser): use public ssrf runtime import in CDP proxy bypass

question: Should the Browser CDP proxy bypass continue using the private owner-scoped `ssrf-runtime-internal` seam, or should `registerManagedProxyBrowserCdpBypass` become part of the public `ssrf-runtime` Plugin SDK contract?
rationale: The current patch cannot be correct without changing the SDK/security boundary or choosing a private resolution repair, and that boundary choice is maintainer-owned.

options.title: Preserve Private Owner-Scoped Access
options.body: Keep the helper private and repair packaged Browser lazy-loading through the existing owner-scoped resolver or staging path, with package smoke proof.

options.title: Approve Public SDK Promotion
options.body: Promote the helper only with explicit SDK/security approval plus docs, entrypoint metadata, guardrail updates, and release-note context.

options.title: Choose A Canonical Replacement
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer one of the sibling branches or a fresh maintainer branch as the canonical repair for the linked regression.

recommendation.title: Preserve Private Owner-Scoped Access
recommendation.body: Keep the helper private and repair packaged Browser lazy-loading through the existing owner-scoped resolver or staging path, with package smoke proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is primarily SDK/package-boundary policy, and steipete authored the relevant package-boundary hardening history.
